briefs: Trump says he will not decide the next step in the Iran war until the new year.
Senate Republicans block a war-powers measure on Iran, 51 votes to 48.
Russia violates Poland's airspace overnight with two missiles and a drone.
Estonia will close its border with Russia for at least six months.
COP31 draft deal drops the call to phase out fossil fuels.
Kenya discharges its last Ebola patient, 37 days after the first case.
GTA 6 launch sales pass $2.3 billion in its first day.
EU and UK leaders open a summit in Brussels; IMF warns public debt nears 100% of world GDP.

hero.deck: An AI-led sell-off drags the S&P 500 down 3.7% to 6,910.39 and the Nasdaq 5.3% lower, erasing the tech index's gains for the year. The Dow falls 1.9% into correction territory as Wall Street suffers its worst week in 18 months.
hero.headline: WALL STREET'S BLACK FRIDAY

tiles.headline: Kyiv bridges hit as Russia strikes overnight
tiles.summary: Russian strikes on Kyiv's bridges kill eight people and injure 28 across nine regions. Ukraine answers with drone strikes on a chemical plant in Russia and a third hit on the Crimea Bridge this week.

tiles.headline: Merz rejects a 'new Yalta' over Europe
tiles.summary: Germany's chancellor warns Europe will not accept a settlement on its future negotiated by the big powers alone, a day after the Trump-Xi-Putin declaration in Shenzhen. Ukraine's allies meet in Berlin.

tiles.headline: Houthi missile damages Saudi wealth-fund tower
tiles.summary: A Houthi missile strikes Riyadh's financial district, damaging the Public Investment Fund tower. Tanker attacks intensify in the Strait of Hormuz and Brent crude rises to $92.57 a barrel.

tiles.headline: World court: Myanmar committed genocide
tiles.summary: The International Court of Justice rules that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority — the first such finding against a state by the world court.

tiles.headline: Anthropic debuts up 17% amid the rout
tiles.summary: Shares in the AI lab close near $97 on their first day of trading, 17% above the $83 offer price, under the ticker ANT — even as the wider tech sell-off deepens around it.
